column1: # Five Guys, from https://www.fiveguys.com/nutritional-allergy-information/ (US Nutrition & Allergen Guide, September 2026; typed in by hand 2026-10-19)
# Five Guys only lists ingredients, so burgers, the hot dog and the veggie sandwich are added up from them (bun + patties + cheese + bacon),
# with calories rounded to 10. A regular burger has 2 patties, a Little one 1, with a slice of cheese per patty. Toppings are separate items.
# Where the guide lists two suppliers, the first one is used. Five Guys doesn't publish added sugars.
